ui.每一点陪伴，都在慢慢生长。: A little companionship, a little growth.
ui.陪伴 +6经验/小时 · 离线 +3经验/小时，最多12小时: Together: 6 XP/h · Away: 3 XP/h, up to 12 h
ui.浇水4精力 · 施肥10精力，单株最多加速半程: Water: 4 · Fertilize: 10 · Care adds up to half a cycle
ui.播种6精力 · 收获4精力，照料间隔至少1分钟: Sow: 6 · Harvest: 4 · At least 1 min between tasks
ui.为小芽和花园手记，换一种配色。: Choose colours for Sprout and the journal.
ui.使用透明背景 PNG，让它成为你的独家伙伴。: Choose a transparent PNG for your companion.
ui.点点小芽，看看它的成长: Click Sprout to see its growth
ui.有精力就照料，休息时也在成长。: Works with energy; grows while resting.
ui.点击草地收起 · 右键装扮花园: Click grass to close · Right-click for more
ui.品种已固定，查看和重启不会重新抽取。: Species stays fixed through viewing and restarts.
ui.成熟后可以收藏换种: Collect when mature to make room
ui.菜畦成熟后由小芽收获，再随机补种。: Sprout harvests ripe crops, then sows new seeds.
ui.轮换：开启 · 成熟后展示1小时: Rotation: on · Display ripe plants for 1 h
ui.按桌面陪伴时间计时；小芽花4精力收藏，再花6精力补种。: Display time counts while the desktop is open. Collecting costs 4 energy; sowing costs 6.
ui.手动收藏和摆回不耗精力。摆回的植物不会自动轮换。: Manual collecting and restoring are free. Restored plants stay in place.
ui.还没有收藏。点击成熟的花园植物，即可收藏。: No plants collected yet. Click a mature garden plant to collect it.
ui.已摆回花园，会一直保留。: Restored. This plant will stay in place.
ui.已收藏，可以补种新植物了。: Collected. There is room for a new plant.
ui.花园已满，请先收藏一株植物: Garden full. Collect a plant first.
ui.这株植物已经摆回花园: This plant has already been restored.
ui.花园已改变，请重新打开植物卡: Garden changed. Reopen this plant card.
ui.植物成熟后才能收藏: This plant must mature before collecting.
ui.只能收藏花园植物: Only ornamental plants can be collected.
ui.暂时读不到记录，请稍后重新打开。: Cannot read the journal. Please reopen it shortly.

ui.游戏使用压缩的五阶段形象与经验进度，不等同于真实生长周期、比例或浇水施肥频率。: Five visual stages and XP compress time. They do not represent real growing times, scale or care schedules.
